cases.title: Add bookmark to specific location (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added to a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add bookmark at hierarchy boundaries (Boundary)
cases.description: Verify adding a bookmark at the root level versus a deeply nested location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Add bookmark to non-existent location (Error)
cases.description: Verify that attempting to add a new bookmark to a non-existent location within the bookmarks hierarchy fails appropriately.

cases.title: Normal Deletion of Bookmark
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and is no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Edge Case Deletion of Non-Existent Bookmark
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to delete a bookmark that has already been deleted or does not exist.

cases.title: Abnormal Deletion with File Permission Error
cases.description: Verify that an appropriate error is handled when a file permission error occurs during the bookmark deletion process.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmark from Personal Toolbar - Normal
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to the personal toolbar and subsequently deleted from it.

cases.title: Personal Toolbar Capacity Limit - Boundary
cases.description: Verify the behavior when adding bookmarks to the personal toolbar up to its maximum capacity limit.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific valid location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Insert bookmark folder at maximum allowed hierarchy depth
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be inserted at the maximum supported nesting depth of the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Insert bookmark folder with invalid name
cases.description: Verify that attempting to insert a new bookmark folder with an invalid or prohibited name format is appropriately handled and rejected.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark normal launch
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a valid bookmark successfully launches the associated URL in a new or current browser window.

cases.title: Double-click bookmark with corrupted or invalid URL
cases.description: Verify the application behavior when double-clicking on a bookmark containing a corrupted or invalid URL, ensuring appropriate error handling.

cases.title: Validate links in default bookmarks file
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links under normal operating conditions.

cases.title: Abnormal handling of broken links in packaged file
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when encountering broken or malformed links within the default bookmarks file packaged with the browser.

cases.title: Normal Change Save Integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Abnormal Data Corruption on Save
cases.description: Verify the system handles data corruption or write failures gracefully when attempting to save changes to a bookmark item.

cases.title: Normal Deletion of Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that an existing bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Edge Case Deletion of Empty versus Non-Empty Folder
cases.description: Verify the deletion behavior when deleting an empty bookmarks folder compared to deleting a non-empty bookmarks folder containing subfolders and items.

cases.title: Add and Delete Bookmarks Separators Normal
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks separators can be successfully added to and deleted from the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Invalid Separator Placement Abnormal
cases.description: Verify the system handles invalid separator placement attempts, such as placing separators in restricted system containers, gracefully.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Normal Restart
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks are successfully saved and persisted after a normal application restart.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Browser Crash
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to bookmarks are successfully preserved and not lost when the browser experiences an unexpected crash.

cases.title: View properties negative test for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify that view properties execute correctly for bookmarks, folders, and separators as a negative test per requirement R-011.

cases.title: Accessing restricted properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators
cases.description: Verify the abnormal scenario where attempting to access restricted or invalid properties for bookmarks, folders, and separators is handled appropriately.

cases.title: Normal - Inline Bookmark Rename
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be renamed inline directly in the UI without opening the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Edge - Rename with Special Characters or Empty String
cases.description: Verify inline renaming behavior when entering edge-case inputs such as special characters, emojis, or attempting to clear the name completely.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using Valid Custom Keyword - Normal
cases.description: Verify that a user can successfully find and access a bookmark by entering its assigned custom keyword in the address bar or search.

cases.title: Find Bookmark With Duplicate Keywords - Edge
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when multiple bookmarks are assigned the same custom keyword (edge scenario).

cases.title: Search With Non-Existent Custom Keyword - Edge
cases.description: Verify that searching for a custom keyword that does not exist returns no bookmarks or an appropriate not-found indication.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort Bookmark Columns (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be successfully sorted and reverse-sorted per column in ascending and descending order.

cases.title: Sort Columns with Empty or Special Characters (Edge)
cases.description: Verify sorting and reverse-sorting behavior on columns containing empty entries or special characters.

cases.title: Normal Column Resizing
cases.description: Resize bookmark columns to show and hide more of the entries successfully.

cases.title: Boundary Column Widths
cases.description: Resize bookmark columns to their minimum and maximum possible width boundaries.

cases.title: Show and Hide Bookmark Columns Normal Operation
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully shown and hidden using the column configuration interface.

cases.title: Hide All Bookmark Columns Boundary Condition
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when attempting to hide all available bookmark columns to ensure edge case compliance.

cases.title: Bulk Delete Several Bookmarks Normal
cases.description: Verify that multiple selected bookmarks are successfully deleted at one time from the bookmarks list.

cases.title: Bulk Delete Zero Bookmarks Edge
cases.description: Verify the system behavior when a bulk delete action is triggered with zero bookmarks selected.

cases.title: Drop bookmark onto itself
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Drop bookmark onto its immediate parent
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto its immediate parent folder.

cases.title: Drop bookmark onto its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark folder onto its immediate child item.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases comprehensively cover normal, boundary, and error/edge scenarios for all requirements. No blockers or missing scenarios were found.
All requirements and test cases have been reviewed. The cases comprehensively cover the specified requirements, including boundaries and error paths.

analysis.analysis: R-001: Normal (add bookmark to specific location), Boundary (add to root vs deep nesting), Abnormal (add to non-existent location). R-002: Normal (delete from file and UI), Edge (delete already deleted/non-existent), Abnormal (file permission error during delete). R-003: Normal (add/delete from personal toolbar), Boundary (toolbar capacity limit). R-004: Normal (insert folder), Boundary (max depth), Abnormal (insert folder with invalid name). R-005: Normal (double-click launches window), Abnormal (double-click corrupted/invalid URL). R-006: Normal (default file links valid), Abnormal (broken links in packaged file). R-007: Normal (save modified item integrity), Abnormal (data corruption on save). R-008: Normal (delete folder), Edge (delete non-empty folder vs empty folder). R-009: Normal (add/delete separators), Abnormal (invalid separator placement). R-010: Normal (save changes over restart/crash), Abnormal (crash corrupts storage file). R-011: Normal (view properties negative test), Abnormal (accessing restricted properties). R-012: Normal (rename inline), Edge (rename with empty string or special characters). R-013: Normal (find by custom keyword), Edge (duplicate keywords, non-existent keyword). R-014: Normal (sort and reverse-sort columns), Edge (empty columns, special characters sorting). R-015: Normal (resize columns), Boundary (minimum and maximum column width). R-016: Normal (show and hide columns), Boundary (hide all columns). R-017: Normal (bulk delete several bookmarks), Edge (delete zero bookmarks, delete all bookmarks). R-018: Abnormal (drop bookmark onto itself, immediate parent, or child).
